messages:
Ravi: Partner CloudVent requested a compact marketplace quickstart: Terraform + helm chart, ARM/x86 variants, single-VPC, optional private registry, and a smoke test that performs /health + a tiny inference. They want a demo in 8 business days.

Sofia: Recommend two flows: `catalog` (pull model from Redwood) and `bring-your-own` (image + registry creds). Catalog is simpler for marketplace listing.

Ben: I'll scaffold modules: network, cluster, app. Add outputs: endpoint, grafana_target. Plan tests/smoke.sh to curl /health and POST /generate with max_tokens=30.

marketplace-bot: Reminder: include README quickstart, supported regions/arches, security notes, and acceptance-test logs per publish checklist: https://internal.redwood/marketplace-publish-checklist

Ravi: Assignments: Ben -> modules + smoke test, Sofia -> README + registry docs, I'll handle partner comms and timeline. Sync Thursday 9am PT.

Ben: Sounds good — starting draft PR today.

Sofia: I'll add nodeSelector examples for arm64 and autoscale defaults min=1 max=3.

Ravi: Thanks team, will DM CloudVent for sandbox account and share checklist when they reply.
